description: Figure: gnomAD v4 variation in the LRP5L ORF matches neutral expectation, with 78 segregating protein-truncating variants
code:
import json, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
g=json.load(open("gnomad_constraint_test.json")); df=pd.read_csv("table_gnomad_cds_variants.csv")
n=g["n_snv"]
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(15.5,4.6))

cls=["synonymous","missense","nonsense","stop_lost"]
e=[g["expected"][c]*n for c in cls]; o=[g["observed"][c]*n for c in cls]
x=np.arange(4); w=.37
ax[0].bar(x-w/2,e,w,label="neutral expectation\n(mutation-spectrum weighted)",color="#999999")
ax[0].bar(x+w/2,o,w,label="observed in gnomAD v4",color="#4c72b0")
for i in range(4):
    ax[0].text(x[i],max(e[i],o[i])*1.12+1.5,f"obs/exp\n{o[i]/e[i]:.2f}",ha="center",fontsize=8)
ax[0].set_yscale("log"); ax[0].set_ylim(1,1200)
ax[0].set_xticks(x); ax[0].set_xticklabels(cls,fontsize=9); ax[0].set_ylabel("segregating SNVs in the 759-nt ORF")
ax[0].legend(fontsize=7.5,loc="upper right"); ax[0].set_title("A  No depletion of any functional class",fontsize=10,loc="left")

ptv=df[df.cls.isin(["nonsense","frameshift","stop_lost"])]
ax[1].vlines(ptv[ptv.cls=="nonsense"].codon,0,np.log10(ptv[ptv.cls=="nonsense"].af*1e6+1),color="#c23b22",lw=1.4,label="nonsense (24)")
ax[1].vlines(ptv[ptv.cls=="frameshift"].codon,0,np.log10(ptv[ptv.cls=="frameshift"].af*1e6+1),color="#e8a33d",lw=1.4,label="frameshift (52)")
ax[1].scatter(ptv[ptv.cls=="nonsense"].codon,np.log10(ptv[ptv.cls=="nonsense"].af*1e6+1),c="#c23b22",s=14,zorder=3)
ax[1].scatter(ptv[ptv.cls=="frameshift"].codon,np.log10(ptv[ptv.cls=="frameshift"].af*1e6+1),c="#e8a33d",s=14,zorder=3)
ax[1].axvspan(231,252,color="#f0c0c0",alpha=.5)
ax[1].text(241,2.6,"frameshift\ntail",ha="center",fontsize=7.5)
ax[1].set_xlabel("codon (1-252)"); ax[1].set_ylabel("log10(allele frequency x 1e6 + 1)")
ax[1].legend(fontsize=8); ax[1].set_title("B  78 truncating variants spread across the whole ORF",fontsize=10,loc="left")

ind=df[df.cls.isin(["frameshift","inframe_indel"])]
fs=(ind.cls=="frameshift").sum(); inf=(ind.cls=="inframe_indel").sum()
ax[2].bar([0,1],[2/3*(fs+inf),fs],color=["#999999","#4c72b0"],width=.5)
ax[2].bar([2.2,3.2],[1/3*(fs+inf),inf],color=["#999999","#4c72b0"],width=.5)
ax[2].set_xticks([0,1,2.2,3.2]); ax[2].set_xticklabels(["exp","obs","exp","obs"],fontsize=9)
ax[2].text(0.5,-9,"frameshift",ha="center",fontsize=9); ax[2].text(2.7,-9,"in-frame",ha="center",fontsize=9)
ax[2].set_ylabel("segregating CDS indels")
ax[2].set_title("C  Indels: 52 frameshift vs 17 in-frame\n(neutral 2:1, binomial p = 0.16)",fontsize=10,loc="left")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
